INSANE CLIENT 1.1.2 — branding and launcher integration

Based on PYES Client by PYES_KING (Owner/Developer).
The supplied artifact declares MIT in fabric.mod.json. Its original author
metadata is preserved. LICENSE_PYES_CLIENT supplies the standard MIT text
and attribution; it was not present as a standalone license file upstream.

Upstream download: https://www.mediafire.com/file/ailnuvks6xrtu9p/PYES-Client-1.1.1.jar/file
Upstream SHA-256: 02095d719da26fa756fe4239025415c60c881d7f18831759a3af764505f7f3ee
The filename says 1.1.1; the embedded manifest declares 1.1.2.

Changes: client title/branding strings, six logo/banner PNG resources, the
launcher-facing mod name/description, and client key-category translations.
The upstream update channel is disabled so it cannot replace this fork.
Core update-entrypoint controls/dashboard registration remain intact.

Internal mod IDs, Java classes, mixins, settings paths and persisted module
names remain unchanged for compatibility. Some module names therefore retain
PYES. The client still uses its upstream game features and implementation.

Bundled Mouse Tweaks and FlySpeed JARs and their notices remain unchanged.
See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, LICENSE_MouseTweaks and the embedded FlySpeed
license. The upstream helper JAR is unchanged but its update channel is off.

This release is a deterministic binary branding patch. The supplied download
contained compiled classes, not Java source. The launcher repository includes
the patch script and branding assets, not a reconstruction of upstream source.
